name: Hallingeberg - Karrum - Odensvi, Tjustleden etapp 6
description: Hallingeberg / Källtorp to Odensvi / Kyrksjön. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official section descriptions run Hallingeberg/Källtorp to Odensvi/Kyrksjön, but official GPX/API linework is stored in the opposite direction.

Official facts simplify the endpoints as Hallingeberg - Odensvi, while detailed text places the start at Källtorpet/Källtorpsstugan and the end at the shelter in northwest Kyrksjön. Odensvi village facilities are via a connection at Frö.
Västervik Outdoor/Naturkartan classify the section as Blå - medel, while Västervik municipality says Något kuperad.
2026 practical advice says Sixgöl may work if boiled, while crowd data marks water quality unknown and official advice says the stage has little drinking water.
Official static route pages present the stage normally, but the trail-owner acute page has active 2026 notices at Lundaborg and Amerika.
OSM relation 3206134 has a 2018 reroute note south of Sixgöl and diverges from the official 2026 GPX/API line; naive OSM assembly has discontinuities.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Hallingeberg Källtorpsstugan / Källtorp hut
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan site 29217; OSM node 3133426887 corroborates nearby.
facilities.description: Official start/handoff overnight hut or shelter at Källtorp/Källtorpsstugan, north of Hallingeberg church. Name variants include Källtorp, Källtorpsstugan, Källstorp, and Kalltorp in different sources.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Tjustleden etapp 6, Sixgöl
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan site 28974; OSM node 3647735344 corroborates nearby.
facilities.description: Mid-stage overnight shelter at Sixgöl. Naturkartan describes it as nicely situated by the lake. Sixgöl water is not potable-confirmed. Keep water as separate pending/treated-lake-water metadata.

facilities.name: Sixgöl dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM maps a pit-latrine toilet operated by Tjust Naturskyddsförening near the Sixgöl shelter. Not listed as a separate Naturkartan facility. Vindskyddskartan has a stale 2023-07-30 hornet warning for the outhouse; current condition should be checked before import.

facilities.name: Sixgöl bathing rocks / Badplats Tjustleden etapp 6
facilities.description: Official description mentions bathing rocks at Sixgöl. No bathing-water sampling source found for Sixgöl.

facilities.name: Hängesten
facilities.description: Named geological boulder formation on/near Tjustleden. Official text describes Hängesten as an interesting geological sight. A nearby generic Naturkartan sight marker appears duplicate; prefer this named record.

facilities.name: Hängesten parking / bench cluster
facilities.description: Parking/rest clue near Hängesten approach. Västervik.com states Hängesten is easy to reach by car. Parking formal status and capacity are not confirmed by an official trail source.

facilities.name: Mårtens Gryt
facilities.description: Official section text and Odensvi local history describe Mårtens Gryt as a marked block cave/legend site near the Karrum/Ogestad boundary. No amenities; OSM says wheelchair=no.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Kyrksjön endpoint
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan site 29216; OSM node 5358933317 corroborates nearby.
facilities.description: Official Section 6 endpoint shelter on a wooded point in northwest Kyrksjön. Official GPX endpoint is about 90 m from the mapped shelter/toilet cluster; normalize endpoint/facility relation carefully.

facilities.name: Kyrksjön endpoint toilet
facilities.description: OSM maps a simple toilet at the Kyrksjön endpoint cluster; official facts say TC exists at the end. OSM explicitly says drinking_water=no.

facilities.name: Odensvi / Kyrksjön bathing area
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan site 48330; OSM and HaV corroborate the area.
facilities.description: Official Section 6 text says the Odensvi connection has a bathing area. HaV lists the 2026 bathing-season classification based on 2025 data as excellent; this is not drinking-water evidence. Off the main route via the Odensvi connection, not on the main Kyrksjön west-shore line.

facilities.name: Odensvi Lanthandel / Café Odensvi Lanthandel
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan site 49526; OSM nodes 3070310427 and 3070310428 nearby.
facilities.description: Official practical advice says Odensvi has a shop. Naturkartan describes cafe/light lunch/takeaway food; Lanthandel page describes hybrid store access. Opening hours and season must be rechecked at import time.

facilities.name: Odensvi Camping
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM way 362426808; Västervik.com and Odensvi Lanthandel pages.
facilities.description: Small paid camping by Kyrksjön with tent pitches and service access via village hall/lanthandel. Private/commercial currentness and season should be rechecked.

facilities.name: Möckelkullen nature reserve / viewpoint
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen describes the 45 m hill/viewpoint and services north of the reserve, including parking, toilet, bathing area, waste bin, and tent site. Side-service cluster belongs to Odensvi/Kyrksjön area, not the main Tjustleden endpoint. Reserve rules include no fire, no camping, and leashed dogs.

facilities.name: Odensvi bath toilets, parking, BBQ/picnic, shelter/changing rooms
facilities.description: OSM and visitor sources show toilet at bath, parking, BBQ, picnic tables/benches, and shelter/changing-room node. Västervik.com confirms toilet building and grill at Kyrksjön. Side-trip cluster; OSM bath toilet has drinking_water=no.
